Hillenbrand et al. (1995) Vowel Acoustic Data

Source: R/data.R
h95.Rd

Acoustic measurements of 12 American English vowels produced by men, women, boys, and girls in /h-V-d/ syllables. This dataset is a standardized copy of the dataset bundled in the phonTools package (Barreda 2015) , originally published by Hillenbrand et al. (1995) .

Usage

data(h95)

Format

A tibble with 1,668 rows and 9 variables:

speaker

Speaker identifier as a factor.

sex

Speaker sex as a factor with levels "female" and "male".

type

Speaker demographic group as a factor with levels "men", "women", "boys", and "girls".

vowel

Standardized Unicode IPA vowel label in phonemic slashes as a factor with 12 levels (see levels(h95$vowel)).

f0

Fundamental frequency in Hertz (Hz).

f1

First formant frequency in Hertz (Hz).

f2

Second formant frequency in Hertz (Hz).

f3

Third formant frequency in Hertz (Hz).

duration

Vowel duration in milliseconds (ms).

Source

Standardized from phonTools::h95 (Barreda 2015) .

References

Hillenbrand J, Getty LA, Clark MJ, Wheeler K (1995). “Acoustic characteristics of American English vowels.” The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, 97(5), 3099–3111.

Barreda S (2015). “phonTools: Functions for phonetics in R.” R package version 0.2-2.1. https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=phonTools.

See also

pb52, swehvd, mixer6

Examples

data(h95)
head(h95)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 9
#>   speaker sex   type  vowel    f0    f1    f2    f3 duration
#>   <fct>   <fct> <fct> <fct> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 1       male  boys  /æ/     238   630  2423  3166      257
#> 2 1       male  boys  /ɑ/     241   831  1676  2602      212
#> 3 1       male  boys  /ɔ/     247   725  1384  2642      242
#> 4 1       male  boys  /ɛ/     214   713  2095  3129      184
#> 5 1       male  boys  /eɪ/    230   534  2690  3335      222
#> 6 1       male  boys  /ɝ/     240   608  1733  2159      227
table(h95$type, h95$vowel)
#>        
#>         /æ/ /ɝ/ /ɑ/ /eɪ/ /ɛ/ /i/ /ɪ/ /oʊ/ /ɔ/ /u/ /ʊ/ /ʌ/
#>   men    45  45  45   45  45  45  45   45  45  45  45  45
#>   women  48  48  48   48  48  48  48   48  48  48  48  48
#>   boys   27  27  27   27  27  27  27   27  27  27  27  27
#>   girls  19  19  19   19  19  19  19   19  19  19  19  19
